BizNote — Repair Shop & Retail Manager, v1.20
All-in-one shop management built for phone, computer, CCTV, and electronics businesses in Sri Lanka — from job intake to invoice, purchasing to delivery, fully offline.
Jobs & documents:
Repair job tracking with photos & parts · Job cards (A4, quarter A4, thermal) · Invoices & quotations with live preview · Item-wise discounts · Hardware checklist · Auto-save draft recovery
Stock & serial tracking:
Inventory with barcode labels · Serial / IMEI tracking from purchase to sale · Scan a serial to bill it · Cost, dealer & retail pricing · Low-stock alerts · Profit margin calculator
Purchasing & suppliers:
Supplier records · Purchase orders with PDF & WhatsApp sending · Partial goods receiving straight into stock
After-sales & delivery:
Warranty claim tracker linked to the original sale · Convert a claim into a repair job · Courier delivery labels with COD, barcode & handling marks
Money & people:
Cash book & multi-wallet accounting · Customer & supplier credit with itemised statements · Technician commission tracking · Multi-user PIN login & accountability · Dashboard & reports
Made your way:
Six colour themes, light & dark · Five font choices · Sinhala & English · Runs on Windows, Android and any browser · Optional shop-WiFi sync between computers
Why BizNote:
Your data stays on your own computer — no cloud, no subscription, no internet needed to run it. Professional invoices in seconds. Built around how Sri Lankan shops actually work.
